notes.title: The new patch: v1.0.3 - Fullscreen PC
notes.notes:
Hello everybody,

According to your feedbacks added support for fullscreen on PC system.
See the image for more information.

http://cdn.akamai.steamstatic.com/steamcommunity/public/images/clans/26018028/48290a6764307748e6ef0a6290feb1d0d2bc9fd3.jpg


If you have any problems, please inform us.


Thanks for all the feedback!
